description: This PHP source file defines the TotalDurationModel class within the OrangeHRM Time API module. The class models a duration in seconds and provides methods to convert it into an associative array with hours, minutes, and a formatted label, implementing the Normalizable interface for serialization.

classes.name: TotalDurationModel
classes.description: A model class representing a total duration, providing serialization to an array with hours, minutes, and a label, based on an input duration in seconds.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TotalDurationModel with a duration in seconds.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the total duration into an associative array with hours, minutes, and a formatted label.
